cases.notes: PicTrail (Instagram-style) post-detail lookup: id concatenated raw into a WHERE clause via a raw connection.cursor() query (never the ORM); real, seeded SQLite backend. CC-LAB-0092, category 2 (Social/UGC platforms) pilot's first real, ground-truth-bearing page.

PicTrail comment body rendered through Django's real template engine after being wrapped in django.utils.safestring.mark_safe(), which marks it 'already safe' and defeats Django's own default template auto-escaping (CWE-79). A deliberately simplified, generic mark_safe()-on-raw-value shape -- not the full @mention/#hashtag auto-linking footgun researched in docs/research/category2-social-ugc-functionality-and-cwe-research.md §4 row 2, which stays a later, separately-scoped increment. This generator's read_stored_field source models the sink side only (no write endpoint is generated) -- source_url deliberately omitted, not silently implied. CC-LAB-0093.

PicTrail's link-preview upload flow fetches an attacker-supplied url server-side via requests.get() with no scheme or resolved-IP check (CWE-918), returning a JSON preview. Ports docs/research/corpus-examples/ssrf/python/vulnerable-oembed-unfurl-4.py almost verbatim. lab/safety_matrix.yaml's own server_side_http_fetch sink family: unchecked_url_fetch/no_effect (this case) vs. scheme_and_resolved_ip_allowlist/neutralises (the secure twin, LABGEN-DJ-0012, not separately ground-truthed here -- same convention as PT-0001/PT-0002's own secure twins). CC-LAB-0094.

PicTrail's account-settings update writes the whole POST body's fields (filtered only to real DB columns, not to the real settings form's own publicly-settable subset) into the profiles row via a raw parameterized connection.cursor() UPDATE, letting a POST body also set the privileged is_verified column the real settings form never exposes (CWE-915). lab/safety_matrix.yaml's own orm_entity_bulk_assign sink family: unfiltered_body_update/no_effect (this case) vs. runtime_field_allowlist/neutralises (the secure twin, LABGEN-DJ-0014, not separately ground-truthed here -- same convention as PT-0001/PT-0002/PT-0003's own secure twins). param names the specific privileged field being smuggled in, matching lab/ground-truth-forgecart's own mass_assignment case (FCART-0004) convention. CC-LAB-0095.
